lakeside.name: Lakeside
lakeside.card: Water events produce 1.5x more water (round up to nearest 0.5 L). Dehydration HP penalties are reduced by 1. Cold exposure unchanged.

glacier_ridge.name: Glacier Ridge
glacier_ridge.card: Every cold-weather event causes an extra 1 HP damage. Water events require a stove to melt ice; without a stove, water gain becomes zero. Slip/fall events deal an extra 1 HP damage.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.card: Food and berry events give +100 kcal. Humid or wet-cold events deal an extra 1 HP. Insect-related events deal an extra 1 HP.

valley_floor.name: Valley Floor
valley_floor.card: All weather exposure HP is reduced by 1. Water events produce 1.2x more water. Navigation events deal 1 HP less (less risk of being lost).

high_plateau.name: High Plateau
high_plateau.card: Sun/UV events deal an extra 1 HP. Wind events deal an extra 1 HP. Navigation events gain 1 HP (better visibility).

scree_slope.name: Scree Slope
scree_slope.card: Slip, fall, sprain, or ankle events deal an extra 1 HP. Equipment damage events deal an extra 1 HP. Food and water are unchanged.

cave_mouth.name: Cave Mouth
cave_mouth.card: Cold night events' damage is reduced by 1. Food spoilage events deal an extra 1 HP. Without headlamp, night navigation events deal an extra 1 HP.

wind_pass.name: Wind Pass
wind_pass.card: Wind-related events deal an extra 2 HP. Rain/snow storms deal an extra 1 HP.

boggy_hollow.name: Boggy Hollow
boggy_hollow.card: Water is easy to find, but always dirty. Without purification, water events cause an extra 1 HP. Insect events deal an extra 1 HP.

old_trail.name: Old Trail
old_trail.card: Navigation events' damage is reduced by 2 HP. Wildlife encounter events (non-attack) become HP 0.
